**27 July 2023**

- Sam asked for low-calorie snacks and title of Evan’s gripping new mystery. Evan suggested air-popped popcorn or fruit with seltzer and named *The Great Gatsby* (despite calling it a mystery). **7 August 2023**
- Evan had recently visited Canada and met an “awesome Canadian woman”; being with her made him feel alive. Shared couple walking hand-in-hand in snow. Sam congratulated him, mentioned health issues, shared beach/surfboard photo.
- Evan said relationship was a nice change after health issues; shared cookies, ginger snaps his weakness. - Evan drove somewhere fun the prior month; views amazing. Sam guessed Banff; Evan confirmed he skied there, enjoyed snow, hoped to return next year. Shared skier and group on snowy slope.
- Evan enjoys skiing, snowboarding, ice skating; invited Sam skiing someday. Sam wanted to try but doubted their body could handle it; said it was difficult but perhaps possible, thanked Evan for understanding.

**27 August 2023, 10:18 am**

- Evan had twisted knee the previous Friday; it was painful and disrupted his usual fitness routine, frustrating because activity was very important to him. Sam expressed sympathy/offered help. Evan said PT was planned, hoped for appointment soon; meanwhile keeping things low-key and swimming. Sam approved swimming as low-impact.
